reason: PURE. objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps? I have wasted money on magnesium that did nothing, and a new brand from one creator video could just be hype.
would_change_my_mind: Several real reviews from moms saying they slept better or had fewer cramps within two weeks, or a small trial size so I do not commit to 30 days.
